subject: Request: Senior Clearance for Hosted API rate concession - HealthIntel
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
To: Zoe Palmer <zoe@healthintel.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot commercial terms + request for senior clearance

Hi Zoe —

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Quick recap and a concrete ask so we can move the pilot forward:

- Scope: Hosted API access for HealthIntel’s patient-summarization pipeline (up to 100M tokens/month initial ramp).
- Standard list rate: $0.0008/token (generation) + embeddings at standard band.
- Your ask: a deeper introductory concession to cover trial economics while you prove model integration.

Based on the expected ramp and strategic signal (embedded partner case study + potential marketplace listing), Ben and I modeled a concession of 28% off list for the first 12 months with the following conditions:
1) 12-month term with a minimum committed spend equivalent to projected Q3 usage in the attached forecast.
2) Quarterly usage review and automatic reversion to list if ramp < 50% of forecast after month 6.
3) Standard security addenda in place (we have SOC 2 + optional VPC for production).

This request exceeds the Deal Desk threshold for commercial concessions (>20%). Can you please review and advise if you can sign off on the commitment? If so, I’ll capture the language in the SOW and route for DocuSign.

Attachments: HealthIntel_SOW_v1.pdf (draft), usage_forecast_HealthIntel_Q3-Q4.xlsx, hostedapi_pricing_sheet_v2.pdf

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if useful.

—Logan
Logan Wright

Appreciate the fast follow and the draft. The team is enthusiastic about a pilot but we need a written executive confirmation for anything >20% off list. Our procurement team requires:

- Executive-level sign-off from Redwood (title + name) on any concession >20%
- The concession to be timeboxed and tied to the attached SOW and forecast
- Confirmation of data handling posture (SOC 2 report or equivalent) — we’ll need the artifact before production go-live.

We’ve attached our SOW template (separate from your draft) and Aaron will be the contracting lead. Can Marcus or someone in your leadership reply with the approval language?

Subject: Re: Pilot commercial terms + request for senior clearance — approval request (28% concession)

Hi Zoe / Aaron —

Thank you for the constructive dialogue. After reviewing the deal economics and the attached forecast, I am approving a one-time commercial concession of 28% off Redwood’s Hosted API list rate for the initial 12-month pilot term subject to the following explicit conditions:

1) Commitment: HealthIntel will sign the attached SOW and commit to the minimum spend specified in usage_forecast_HealthIntel_Q3-Q4.xlsx.
2) Timebox: The concession applies for 12 months from the effective date in the SOW and will revert to standard list pricing thereafter unless a renewal is negotiated.
3) Performance gates: If HealthIntel’s actual billed usage is less than 50% of the forecast during month 6, Redwood reserves the right to convert remaining months to list pricing or require the remaining committed spend as an upfront credit.
4) Finance terms: The concession will be delivered as an upfront credit applied monthly against invoices; any unpaid invoices after 60 days will void the concession.
5) Security requirement: SOC 2 Type II report or equivalent must be provided prior to production access.

Please confirm acceptance of these conditions and we’ll attach this message to the SOW as the executive concession language for HealthIntel’s procurement. If you prefer a signed addendum instead of an email-stamped approval, let us know and we will route through DocuSign.

Approved by: Marcus Lin
VP, Global Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
